request.spec:
The remainder of a pool's cuts now goes to the member with the smallest non-zero cut, the latest
added on a tie (a member with no cut gets none; a pool with no non-zero cut gives it to the last
member with a share).
request.prompt:

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The remainder of a pool's cuts now goes to the member with the smallest non-zero cut, the latest

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.

agent.result_text:
A pool's leftover cent now goes to the member with the smallest non-zero cut instead of the one with the largest share. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 acceptance tests.

The change is one method in `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/pool/RespondWithPools.java`, which works out the cuts and spreads the remainder. I updated the comment there to describe the new rule. The cuts are only worked out on the server, so the stored data and the front end didn't need to change.

How the remainder is now handed out:
- **Usual case:** it goes to the member whose rounded cut is the smallest non-zero one. If several members tie, the one added last gets it.
- **Members with no cut:** a member who is held, retired, or whose dates don't include the sheet's today still gets 0.00 and never receives the remainder.
- **Every eligible cut rounds to 0.00:** the remainder goes to the last eligible member in the pool.

I read "a member with a share" in the request as a member who is eligible for a cut. If it should also cover held or retired members, that's a one-line change.

When no member can have a cut at all (everyone held or retired), all cuts stay 0.00 and nobody gets the remainder, as before.
